phase13_3_xlsx_advisory.status: RESOLVED — documented risk acceptance; vulnerable code paths unreachable

package.name: xlsx
package.registry_fix: none on npmjs (SheetJS moved distribution to their own CDN after 0.18.5)

advisories.title: Prototype Pollution in SheetJS
advisories.trigger: parsing a crafted spreadsheet via XLSX.read

advisories.title: SheetJS Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
advisories.trigger: parsing a crafted spreadsheet via XLSX.read

usage_inventory: frontend/src/utils/reportExport.js — import * as XLSX; aoa_to_sheet, book_new, book_append_sheet, XLSX.write (client-side Excel export)
csvSanitize.js + ReportFilters.jsx — export-name/sanitization helpers, no parsing
zero XLSX.read, readFile, sheet_to_json, or xlsx upload/parse handlers in src/ or backend/app
reachability_analysis: Both CVEs require the library to PARSE attacker-controlled spreadsheet input
Pawesome only WRITES .xlsx files client-side from data the API already returned to the user
No upload path feeds xlsx to the parser — the vulnerable code path is unreachable by any role
Runs in the report-viewer's own browser: worst case is a user affecting only their own session with data they already had
decision: RISK ACCEPTED for the current usage pattern — exploitation requires an xlsx-PARSE feature that does not exist
REQUIRED GUARD: any future spreadsheet IMPORT/upload feature must not use xlsx.read without a pinned fixed build

RECOMMENDED (not blocking): pin the SheetJS CE tarball from the official CDN (0.20.x line, e.g. https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz) or migrate to exceljs when dependency state is next touched — NOT done now to avoid unreviewed lockfile changes
RE-TRIGGER: revisit if npm audit surface changes or an import feature is added
phase13_3_xlsx_advisory.evidence_grep: no XLSX.read / readFile / sheet_to_json / FormData-xlsx matches in src/ or backend/app
